description: Weekly US retail gasoline prices from EIA. Filter by region (PADD1-PADD5 or national) and grade (regular, midgrade, premium, diesel, all). Useful for fuel-cost analysis, transportation logistics, and consumer price tracking.

end.description: Inclusive upper-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM).

region.description: PADD region code or 'national'. Examples: 'national', 'PADD1', 'PADD3'. Default 'national'.

start.description: Inclusive lower-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM depending on series cadence).

name: eia_gasoline_prices
